correctness.rationale: The displayed quartic is smooth by primary sources; the order-61 diagonal action preserves F and has determinant one; derivative relations eliminate pure cubes in the 35-dimensional degree-three Jacobian ring. All 30 surviving monomial weights, the 30 complementary conjugates, 12 coset witnesses and exact order-five stabilizer are exhaustively verified by the standalone path verify.py. The dimension-60 rational Hodge structure is rank one over Q(zeta61). Its CM type is induced from the primitive degree-12 fixed field, giving an unpolarized fivefold isogeny to a simple CM sixfold and matrix algebra of rational endomorphisms by Milne's cited classification. Integral polarized splitting is neither assumed nor concluded.

value.rationale: The unpolarized isogeny decomposition and entire rational endomorphism algebra of a geometrically distinguished 30-dimensional intermediate Jacobian are natural basic structural invariants; they show the abelian variety is not simple and quantify the exact simple factor dimension six, multiplicity five and endomorphism-algebra dimension 300. This is substantially finer than automorphism-group classification and distinct from the previously known polarized non-Jacobian theorem. The exact fixed field and CM type are essential, not arbitrary numerical slices.
